pane.title: DSH Office Runner
pane.subtitle: Drives this document from a DSH session
pane.modeHint: Ask: overwriting actions wait for your approval here. Auto: they run immediately and return the before/after state. Keep this pane open.
pane.logActionsFailed: ⚠️ actions hot-reload failed (version mismatch or not executed), will retry
pane.rejectMessage: The user rejected this action in the task pane
pane.timeoutMessage: Approval timed out with no response; cancelled

messages.forbiddenOrigin: Cross-origin request rejected: this bridge only serves its own add-in page and local callers
messages.badJson: request body is not valid JSON
messages.bodyTooLarge: request body exceeds the limit (max {max} bytes)
messages.badEncoding: request body is not valid UTF-8 (JSON must be sent as UTF-8 bytes)
messages.bodyObjectRequired: request body must be a JSON object
messages.commandArgsInvalid: host, instance, args or idempotencyKey has an invalid type or value
messages.idempotencyConflict: idempotencyKey was already used with different command arguments
messages.instanceHostMismatch: host does not match the target document instance
messages.commandInstanceMismatch: instance does not match the command target
messages.resultArgsInvalid: commandId and instance must be strings, and ok must be a boolean
messages.commandNotStarted: the command must be claimed before returning a successful result
messages.requestFailed: the bridge could not process this request
messages.instanceRequired: An add-in instance is required (instanceId): call GET /office/status first and pick the target from `instances` (identify the document by docUrl), then resend with `instance`. With several documents open, omitting it makes the wrong document execute the command.
messages.busy: a command is already pending (the previous one is still executing); retry shortly
messages.addinOfflineInstanceMissing: No such add-in instance (instanceId={instance}): make sure the task pane is open in the target document, or re-read /office/status for the current instance
messages.addinOfflineStale: That add-in instance is offline (its task pane was closed): reopen the task pane in that document
messages.addinOfflineHost: The "{host}" task pane is not open: open the document and enable "DSH Office Runner" under Home/Developer → Add-ins → Developer Add-ins, keep it open, then retry
messages.timeout: timeout: no add-in heartbeat or execution result
messages.actionsBundleUnavailable: failed to assemble the actions bundle: {message}
messages.logManifestWriteFailed: could not write the runtime manifest, skipping auto-registration: {message}
messages.logNonWindows: not Windows, skipping add-in auto-registration; load the manifest by hand: {manifest}
messages.logPortChanged: if the port just changed, close and reopen your Office documents to refresh the pane
messages.logRegisterFailed: add-in auto-registration failed (run sideload.ps1 manually); the manifest is at {manifest}
messages.logBridgeAnnounceFailed: could not write the bridge announcement: {message}

instance_required.meaning: The command has no `instance` (with several documents open you must name the target instance)
instance_required.action: Call GET /office/status and pick the target from `instances` (identify the document by docUrl), then resend with `instance`

addin_offline.meaning: The target task pane is not open, or has gone offline
addin_offline.action: Ask the user to open the "DSH Office Runner" pane in that document; do not retry

busy.meaning: The previous command is still executing (the queue is occupied)
busy.action: Wait a moment and resend the same command

bad_json.meaning: The request body is not valid JSON
bad_json.action: Check the POST body format and resend

body_too_large.meaning: The request body exceeds the server limit (64 MiB by default)
body_too_large.action: Shrink the body (write in batches, or use a smaller image/HTML payload) and resend

bad_encoding.meaning: The request body is not valid UTF-8: the server decodes strictly, so invalid bytes are rejected instead of silently replaced with garbage
bad_encoding.action: Resend the POST body as UTF-8 bytes (PowerShell: [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes; do not rely on the local code page), then retry

bad_args.meaning: Missing or invalid arguments (no action, invalid host, missing required parameter)
bad_args.action: Fix the arguments as the error text describes and resend

timeout.meaning: No result arrived before the deadline (180s by default); a timeout after execution starts does not undo writes
timeout.action: Query GET /office/commands/:id with commandId. For execution_unknown, await a late result or verify manually; do not blindly resend. Only expired with executionStarted=false confirms execution never started

unknown_action.action: Call GET /office/capabilities for the supported names and resend with the right one

unsupported_host.meaning: That action is not supported in the current application (e.g. `search` is Word-only)
unsupported_host.action: Switch to a supported action or a different application, as the error text describes

confirm_required.meaning: In ask mode an overwriting action needs the user's approval
confirm_required.action: Wait for the user to preview and approve in the Office pane. Approval authorizes a private execution entry for that command only; caller-supplied confirm:true is ignored

rejected.meaning: The user rejected the action in the pane (or approval timed out, which counts as rejection)
rejected.action: Stop, respect the decision, and offer an alternative; do not resend

not_found.meaning: The locate/search target does not exist (bookmark, text, named range, range address, …)
not_found.action: Tell the user honestly that nothing was found and do not repeat the same lookup; suggest different keywords or a different anchor

readonly.meaning: The document is read-only or in view mode, so overwriting actions were refused
readonly.action: Tell the user the document is read-only and to save an editable copy or switch to edit mode; do not retry

requirement.meaning: The current Office environment lacks the required API (e.g. the comments API is unavailable)
requirement.action: Tell the user honestly that the feature is unavailable here; never fake success

unsupported.meaning: That argument combination is not supported in this environment (e.g. dryRun for Excel replace_all)
unsupported.action: Use a supported call shape, as the error text describes

execution.action: Report the error to the user verbatim; if it is an Office.js environment limitation, judge from the error text

semantics.behavior: No matches returns ok:true + count:0 (not an error)
semantics.action: Tell the user nothing was found; do not retry

semantics.behavior: Empty content returns ok:true + an empty array/string (not an error)
semantics.action: Just handle the empty result normally

semantics.behavior: Returns the cursor context "left | right" (| = cursor position); not an error

semantics.action: Verify the write against afterState/document instead of trusting it blindly

args.text: string, required: text that replaces the selection

args.dryRun: boolean, optional: only return the hit count, do not execute

args.text: string, required: paragraph appended at the end of the document

returns.result.tables: [{index,rowCount,columnCount,style,styleBuiltIn,cells:string[][]}]; 1-based table indexes; native values preserve empty cells, line breaks and whitespace without separator rows

args.tableIndexes: number[], optional: 1-based, defaults to all tables
args.enableGrid: boolean, optional: apply TableGrid first so the full grid exists
args.width: Optional positive width in pt; omitted preserves existing width

args.targets: required [{index,expectedText}]; zero-based integer index and exact string text; not paragraphs. Final paragraph and paragraphs containing inline pictures cannot be deleted; index 0 is allowed when nonfinal.

args.style: string, optional: built-in style such as Heading1

args.rows: array, required: rectangular 2-D array, at most 1000 rows / 63 columns / 10000 cells
args.style: string, optional: localized/custom table style name only
args.styleBuiltIn: string, optional: language-neutral built-in style enum, e.g. GridTable4_Accent1; cannot be combined with style
args.headerRow: boolean, optional: treat the first row as a header row

args.html:
required string, at most 8*1024*1024 UTF-16 code units; objects/arrays/numbers rejected; serialize the whole request once; example {html:"

Text

",target:"body",mode:"append"}

args.expectedText: string, optional: verify the source text before writing
args.overwrite: boolean, optional: must be true to replace a non-empty target

args.lineSpacing: Optional positive point value; 18pt does not prove native 1.5-line spacing. Use a native preset and export verification for multiples.
args.listType: none|numbered|bulleted; WordApi1.3; existing lists must be explicitly removed before conversion

args.selectionText: string, optional (Word): comment on the selection containing this text

args.includeFields: optional boolean; WordApi1.5; read actual native field type/code/text

args.text: optional string; required unless field is provided
args.field: optional {type:TOC|Page|NumPages,switches?}; mutually exclusive with text; requires WordApi1.5

args.paragraph: optional {index:non-negative integer,expectedText:string}; exact native paragraph target

word_insert_caption.description: Static numbering needs WordApi 1.1+; a dynamic SEQ field needs WordApi 1.5+ (unavailable on this machine)

args.label: string
args.title: string
args.dynamic: boolean, optional, defaults to false; true attempts a dynamic SEQ field
args.number: number, optional: static numbering starts at 1

args.limit: number, optional: positive integer maximum cells to load; default and hard cap are 5000
args.withLayout: Optional boolean: read actual wrap/alignment and supported point dimensions (mixed values remain null)

args.autoFit: Optional boolean: compatible alias for autoFitColumns; ExcelApi 1.2+
args.columnWidth: Optional positive width in pt; mutually exclusive with autoFitColumns:true or autoFit:true
args.rowHeight: Optional positive height in pt; mutually exclusive with autoFitRows:true
args.autoFitRows: Optional boolean: autofit row height; ExcelApi1.2
args.autoFitColumns: Optional boolean: autofit columns; ExcelApi 1.2+; cannot combine true with columnWidth. autoFit is a compatible alias.

args.title: string, optional
args.position: Optional {startCell,endCell}: local A1 corners on the dataRange worksheet. Always creates on the source worksheet, never an unrelated active sheet
args.font: optional font family; Chinese default SimSun

args.columns: array, optional: [{column:1,filterType:'Values',criteria:{values:['a']}}]; column is 1-based, Values also accepts criteria:['a']; Custom uses criteria:{criterion1:'>2'}

read_slides.description: Reads the currently selected slide range, not the whole deck; use read_document for the whole presentation

args.targetSize: object, required: real target size in points {width,height}
args.elements: array, required: text|shape|line elements; shared x/y/w/h; text supports font/size/color/bold/italic/align/valign/margins/autoFit/runs, shape supports shapeType/fill/lineColor, line supports connectorType/color/lineWidth/dashStyle

args.slideIds: string[], required: exact slide IDs; refuses to delete every slide

args.shapeIds: string[], required: exact shape IDs; returns the remaining IDs after deletion

args.width: number, optional: PNG width, defaults to 960
args.height: number, optional: PNG height, defaults to 540
args.slideIds: Optional unique nonempty native slide ID array; omitted means all pages. Output preserves document order and original 1-based indexes; all IDs checked before rendering

args.withStyles: Optional boolean: read text/font/fill when supported, otherwise report stylesRead:false and reason

args.slideId: optional string: select exact native slide before inserting image

args.style: PowerPoint.TableStyle enum string, optional, e.g. MediumStyle2Accent1

args.keys: array, optional: settings keys to read (e.g. ["lang","theme"])

args.value: any, required: any JSON value (persisted with the document, readable across sessions)

args.bookmark: string, optional: Word bookmark / Excel named range
args.text: string, optional: locate the first matching text
args.sheet: string, optional (Excel): the worksheet to use
args.blinks: number, optional: number of blinks (0 = select and hold; 1-5 blinks)
args.interval: number, optional: blink interval in ms (default 300, 100-800)

args.targets: required 1..500 exact targets [{index,expectedText,style?,font?:{name,size,color,bold,italic},alignment?,spaceBefore?,spaceAfter?,lineSpacing?,leftIndent?,rightIndent?,firstLineIndent?}]; unique zero-based indexes and full-text preflight. style belongs inside each target; style-only patches supported. Built-in aliases or existing document paragraph style names (WordApi1.5 for document names). alignment accepts left|center|right|justify or Left|Centered|Right|Justified and returns normalized lowercase. Dimensions in pt; lineSpacing18 is not true1.5 spacing

word_format_paragraphs.description: Format exact guarded paragraphs using built-in aliases or existing document paragraph styles

args.range: For range mode only: local A1 range to freeze, e.g. A1:B2; not a cursor anchor

args.updates: Required 1..500 patches: {shapeId,text?,font?:{name,size,color,bold,italic},fill?:{color,transparency},left?,top?,width?,height?}; geometry/font size in pt. Only supplied fields change. text replaces the whole text, not runs; font/text/fill limited to TextBox/GeometricShape.

args.address: Required range address; render the whole range as PNG for visual review
args.maxCells: Optional integer 1..10000, default5000; reject over-budget ranges without truncating

args.type: pptx|pdf; default pptx; native Office export

list_sheets.description: Read all worksheet names, positions and visibility

excel_export_file.description: Export using the native Office File API; actual host support is required

args.names: optional string[]: actual document names or supported Chinese/English built-in aliases; omit to list all paragraph styles; prefer returned actual name

returns.result.styles: [{name,type,builtIn,font,paragraphFormat}]; alignment normalized to left|center|right|justify; other host values preserved

word_read_styles.description: Read actual global paragraph style definitions and script-specific fonts

args.styles: required 1..100 {name,font?,paragraphFormat?}; existing document names or supported Chinese/English built-in aliases such as Normal/Title/Heading1. Missing styles are not created. type is read-only and must not be sent. font accepts name/size/color/bold/italic; paragraphFormat accepts paragraph fields with canonical alignment or Office enum values. Alternatively the single reserved body-1.5 atlas preset. Numeric lineSpacing is points, not a multiple

returns.result: {host,global,updated,styles,verified,verification:[{requestedName,name,fields:[{field,requested,actual,status:applied|mismatch|unverified}]}],verificationWarnings?}; ok=true means execution, inspect verified and per-field status for actual application; preset returns its separate created/styles fields

word_set_styles.description: Patch global paragraph styles and compare each requested field with readback; affects all paragraphs using the style

word_read_fields.description: Read actual Word field codes and cached results

args.paragraph: TOC-only optional{index,expectedText}; zero-based body paragraph with exact complete-text guard. Uses the available native Desktop1.4 contents collection with default heading levels1–3; custom switches are rejected before mutation. Reads back actual generated entries

word_insert_field.description: Insert and read back real TOC or PAGE fields

word_create_document.description: Natively create and open a blank Word document; no file/Base64 input; original content preserved

excel_set_print_layout.description: Set bounded native worksheet print area and page layout with readback

args.address: sheet-local A1 rectangle; at most 10000 cells

get_environment.description: Read Office environment, native API support and confirmation mode

args.syncConfig: optional boolean; sync pane to existing user-selected server confirmation mode; no mode/approval input
args.reloadPane: optional boolean; reload this pane only after public command status is explicitly empty; leaves the document intact

returns.result: Environment diagnostics; Word pagination at probe.nativeDiagnostics.pagination, section info under probe.nativeDiagnostics when supported; do not read nonexistent result.pagination

word_render_pages.description: Read-only native Word full-page PNGs including headers/footers; Windows desktop Word PrintLayout required

args.expectedPageCount: required integer 1..10; expected native page count

returns.result: {pages:[{index,width,height,base64,...}],pageCount,renderer,documentFingerprint,...}; unique exact document match only, no closest-candidate fallback; no-match errors include matching diagnostics, other errors report the specific reason
